objective: Identify archived native-task-0 successes with recorded actions and robot state, separate from the already-inspected current-recipe 24-trace population.
selection_rule: From all five historical V3 010000 Phase N positive-checkpoint benchmark initializations 0-4, retain every run whose archived native terminal summary reports success=True. Do not select on any geometric or stage proxy.

source_archive.instruction: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
source_archive.state_capture_script_hash_scope: Current remote file hash matches repository scripts/eval_v3_task0.py and its visible reset, action and state-capture semantics; the Phase N source-time file hash was not embedded in the archived CSVs.
source_archive.evaluator_hash_scope: Current remote file hash matches the prior historical positive-control repeatability record; the Phase N source-time evaluator hash was not independently embedded in the archived CSVs.
source_archive.capture_columns: step, reward, raw_action_0..6, processed_action_0..6, applied_action_0..6, state_0..14

official_bddl_object_identity_observed_c.scope: Read from the currently installed BDDL whose SHA256 is recorded above; require a fresh BDDL/hash and live-object check before any future replay.

scope_and_limits.disjointness: Different archived historical V3 checkpoint/run family and source action files from the current-recipe 40k 24-trace diagnostic replay; no claim that benchmark init indices are disjoint.
scope_and_limits.prior_exposure: These Phase N traces were previously examined for gripper/action proxies. They are candidate independent source actions for a future stage-observable falsification check, not a pristine population for all proxy discovery or threshold tuning.
scope_and_limits.cross_model_limit: Historical V3 010000 positive control is not the current-recipe 40k policy; success of one does not establish success or failure stage of the other.
scope_and_limits.replay_status: No replay of these three traces has been run in this inventory. Source/replay success, step, reward and robot-state parity are unverified.
scope_and_limits.measurement_status: No object-identity or necessary-stage event has been validated on these traces. A missed event in any successful control invalidates a necessary-predecessor claim under frozen capture semantics.
scope_and_limits.publication: Only this lightweight inventory is publishable. Raw action/state CSVs, checkpoints, datasets, credentials and logs remain on the GPU.

recommended_next_action: Design a separately authorized recorded-action replay against these hash-pinned files, with exact task/reset/evaluator compatibility and source/replay parity checks before any stage interpretation. Do not run replay, policy inference or training from this inventory alone.
